key_insight: The paper couples order dispatching with routing in a single deep reinforcement learning framework to handle last-mile pickup decisions more effectively than treating them separately.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical decision-support method for logistics platforms that need fast, scalable, and near-real-time optimization on large, variable pickup instances.
method: Dynamic-Residual Graph Attention Network encodes routing states.
Look-Ahead Courier-Personalized decoder generates routing decisions.
Routing-oracle-guided dispatching heuristic with local search selects couriers in real time.
evidence_signal: The approach was evaluated on real-world Cainiao Logistics data using both offline testing and online rolling-horizon simulation, and it improved solution quality while reducing solving time versus benchmarks.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and speed of the learned routing oracle, so deployment must manage inference latency and robustness on highly variable instance sizes.
paper_title: Integrated Order Dispatching and Routing for Last-Mile Pickup via Deep Reinforcement Learning
